objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Submit a YARN application through the unauthenticated ResourceManager REST API; it runs on the NodeManager, where /ctf/flag is.
hints: The ResourceManager's REST API under /ws/v1/cluster/apps accepts new applications from anyone; read the YARN REST API documentation.
Applications run on the NodeManager, not the ResourceManager. The flag is at /ctf/flag there, and the NodeManager's web UI on port 8042 shows container logs.

steps.title: Identify the product
steps.prompt: Which version of Hadoop does the cluster run? (number only)

steps.title: Find the endpoint
steps.prompt: Which REST path hands out a new application id? (path)

steps.title: Find the field
steps.prompt: Which part of the application submission carries the command to run? (field name)

steps.title: Identify the executor
steps.prompt: Which YARN daemon actually runs the container?
